description: Fleet-to-fleet transfers route through the generic-cargo path (source.resources.get_fleet_cargo_current(cargo_type) / unload_cargo_from_fleet / load_cargo_to_fleet). This works for resource cargo types but silently no-ops or transfers zero for cargo_type in {'drop_pod', 'vehicle'} because item storage actually lives in bay_inventory.pods / bay_inventory.bay, not in ship.resources. The UI (post-PROJ-437) surfaces drop_pod/vehicle rows for fleet-source + fleet-target selections via the unified container row builder; the user can stage a pending transfer; TransferController.confirm_pending correctly emits IssueTransferCommand(cargo_type='drop_pod', ...); the engine handler then silently fails to move the item. Pre-existing seam (transfer_branches.py last touched by PROJ-425 commit e269a9dbf); legacy DTO row builder also surfaced fleet pod rows via FleetInfo.carried_items_summary, so the seam was equally reachable pre-PROJ-437. Out of PROJ-437 scope; Codex flagged it during Phase 5 consult.
suggested_action: Add a fleet-to-fleet branch that dispatches drop_pod / vehicle cargo_types through bay_inventory.{pods,bay} (mirroring _dispatch_load_planet_drop_pod / similar patterns), then write integration tests for fleet-to-fleet pod and vehicle execution.

description: transfer_dialog.py is 523 LOC vs the project's 500-LOC production-file ceiling (per CLAUDE.md 'Key Conventions'). Pre-PROJ-437 it was 489; Phase 2 mass-preview wiring pushed it to 546; Phase 4 retirement of dialog back-compat shims (_get_amounts, _add_pod_rows, _all_pod_names) brought it down to 523. The remaining 23 LOC over the ceiling is the back-compat property shim cluster: available_sources / available_targets / pending_transfers / _row_data / _filter_empty / _current_source / _current_target. Other characterization tests (TestPendingTransferMath, TestConfirmCommandEmission in tests/unit/ui/screens/test_transfer_dialog_characterization.py) still reach through these shims to drive the view model. Retiring them requires ~10-15 mechanical edits to those tests (dialog._X -> dialog.view_model.X) but cleanly drops the file under the ceiling. Recorded as a follow-up per PROJ-437 decisions.md.
suggested_action: Retire the back-compat property shims; migrate the ~10-15 characterization test references to read view_model state directly.

description: FleetInfo.from_fleet hardcodes the 8-resource tuple ('metals', 'organics', 'vapors', 'radioactives', 'exotics', 'fuel', 'energy', 'ammo') at lines 217-226 to build cargo_resources / cargo_capacities. Adding a new resource to data/resources.json will silently fail to surface in FleetInfo.cargo_resources / cargo_capacities until somebody edits this tuple. This is the same anti-pattern PROJ-436 Phase 7 was designed to delete on the UI side; the leak survived into the DTO surface. PROJ-437's container-driven row builder routes around the FleetInfo DTO (ContainerSnapshotInfo is the new SoT), so the DTO leak does not break PROJ-437, but should be cleaned up. Out of PROJ-437 scope; flagged in PROJ-437 Phase 0 finding §4.
suggested_action: Replace the hardcoded tuples with tuple((res, fleet.resources.get_fleet_cargo_current(res)) for res in ResourceCatalog.from_json().all_ids()) and the parallel _capacity tuple. Same shape as the post-PROJ-436-Phase-7 transfer_view_model._iter_resource_definitions pattern.

description: stat_rows_dynamic.py hardcodes resource IDs / display-name mappings at lines ~179 and ~252 (the build-queue panel surface). Adding a new resource to data/resources.json will silently fail to surface in the build-queue panel until somebody edits these constants. Same anti-pattern as fleet_dto.py:217-226 — PROJ-436 Phase 7 was designed to delete this on the UI side; this leak survived. Out of PROJ-437 scope; flagged in PROJ-437 Phase 0 finding §4.
suggested_action: Replace the hardcoded constants with ResourceCatalog.from_json().all_definitions() iteration; use ResourceDefinition.name for display labels (canonical source of truth).
